title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1 – Collocation Rehberi
description: Task 1 soru tiplerine göre gruplandırılmış İngilizce collocation'lar, Türkçe karşılıklar, örnekler ve gramer notları.

line_graph.title: Line Graph – Çizgi grafikleri

entries.example: The city experienced a substantial increase in population.
The period witnessed a marked rise in employment.
The figures followed an upward trend.
Sales reached a peak of $5 million.

groups.title: En yüksek ve en düşük noktalar

entries.en: converge towards the end of the period

model_sentences: The number of people participating in table tennis rose sharply, particularly after 2010, reaching approximately 55 by the end of the period.
Although the figure remained relatively stable during the first decade, it experienced a substantial increase over the following ten years.
The number of participants in amateur dramatics declined steadily, falling from approximately 25 in 2005 to just 5 in 2020.
Following a slight increase, the figure experienced a dramatic decline over the remainder of the period.
Despite some minor fluctuations, attendance at the film club remained relatively stable at around 60 participants.
After falling slightly in 2010, the figure recovered gradually, returning to approximately its initial level by 2020.
While participation in table tennis increased substantially, the number of people attending amateur dramatics followed the opposite trend.
The gap between the two activities widened considerably after 2010.

bar_chart.title: Bar Chart – Sütun grafikleri

entries.en: be approximately twice as high as

entries.tr: en yüksek ikinci değere sahip olmak
sayı bakımından büyük ölçüde fazla olmak

entries.en: be nearly double the figure for

model_sentences: Australia recorded the highest figure for international student enrolments, followed by Canada and the United Kingdom.
The proportion of male participants was considerably higher than that of females in three of the five categories.
Germany recorded the highest percentage of renewable energy consumption, followed by France and Italy.
Japan ranked second, with approximately 35% of respondents choosing public transport.
There was a considerable gap between the two groups.
There was only a marginal difference between male and female participants.
The chart reveals a striking contrast between the two countries.
France recorded a similar figure to Germany.
Female students substantially outnumbered their male counterparts.
The figure for Canada was nearly double that for Italy.

pie_chart.title: Pie Chart – Pasta grafikleri

entries.en: experience an increase in its share
experience a decline in its share

model_sentences: Transportation accounted for the largest proportion of household expenditure, representing approximately 35% of total spending.
Food and housing collectively made up more than half of the household budget.
Approximately one-third of total expenditure was allocated to housing, while one-fifth was spent on transportation.
Although coal remained the dominant source of energy, its share declined considerably over the period.
Renewable energy accounted for a growing proportion of total energy production.

table.title: Table – Tablolar

entries.en: account for a declining share of the total
grow to nearly three times its original size
entries.tr: ilk büyüklüğünün yaklaşık üç katına çıkmak

model_sentences: In 1800, the population of New York City stood at 79,216, with Manhattan accounting for approximately 76% of the total.
The figures varied considerably across the five boroughs.
The city’s population more than doubled, rising from approximately 3.4 million to just over 8 million.
Although Manhattan experienced relatively modest population growth over the entire period, its share of the city’s total population declined substantially.

process.title: Process Diagram – Süreç diyagramları

entries.en: at the beginning of the process

model_sentences: The process begins with the harvesting of ripe grapes, which are subsequently transported to a processing facility.
Once the fermentation stage is complete, the wine is transferred to storage containers for further processing.
The grapes are crushed to extract the juice, which is subsequently transferred to a fermentation tank.
The collected plastic bottles are broken down into smaller pieces before being processed into reusable materials.
The harvested grapes are transported to the processing facility.
The extracted juice is stored in large containers.
The finished product is packaged and distributed to retailers.
The water evaporates from the surface and subsequently condenses to form clouds, before returning to the ground as precipitation.

map.title: Maps – Haritalar
model_sentences: A new residential complex was constructed in the northern part of the town.
The old car park was replaced by a modern shopping centre.
Several old buildings were demolished to make way for a new sports facility.
The former agricultural land was converted into a residential neighbourhood.
Overall, the area underwent substantial redevelopment, with several new residential and commercial facilities being constructed, while much of the agricultural land was removed.
The newly constructed library was located adjacent to the main entrance, while a small garden was introduced in the north-eastern corner of the campus.

mixed_charts.title: Mixed Charts – Karma grafikler

entries.en: a similar pattern can be observed in
this trend is also reflected in
a notable difference can be seen between

entries.tr: her iki veri grubu da ... gösterir

model_sentences: While the bar chart reveals a steady increase in energy consumption, the pie charts indicate a gradual shift towards renewable energy sources.
A similar pattern can be observed in both datasets, with younger age groups recording consistently higher figures.

general.title: Bütün soru tiplerinde kullanılabilecek ifadeler

entries.en: Overall, the most striking feature is...
A clear upward trend can be observed in...

entries.tr: X en büyük kategori olarak kaldı

entries.en: X consistently recorded the highest figures.
entries.tr: X sürekli en yüksek değerleri kaydetti

entries.en: By contrast, Y experienced a substantial decline.
The process consists of several distinct stages.
towards the end of the period
by the end of the period
at the beginning of the period
over the course of two decades
during the latter half of the period

model_sentences: The line graph illustrates changes in the number of participants attending five different activities at a community centre between 2000 and 2020.
The two maps compare the layout of a college café before and after its redevelopment.

Overall, the film club consistently attracted the highest number of participants, while amateur dramatics experienced a substantial decline. Table tennis, meanwhile, recorded the most significant growth over the period.
Overall, the area underwent extensive redevelopment, with several new facilities being introduced and the existing infrastructure significantly expanded.
Overall, wine production is a linear process consisting of several stages, beginning with the harvesting of grapes and ending with the packaging of the finished product.
While sales increased, production declined.
Germany recorded 40%, whereas France stood at 25%.
By contrast, the figure for Italy remained stable.
In comparison, the figure for Spain was relatively low.
Sales were higher compared with the previous year.
Unlike Germany, France experienced a decline.
In contrast to other categories, transport expenditure increased.
Although sales fluctuated, the overall trend was upward.
Despite a temporary decline, the figure recovered.
The figure remained relatively stable during the first decade before increasing dramatically in the years that followed.
Most of the growth occurred during the latter half of the period.

examples.en: The population increased from 3 million to 8 million.

grammar_notes.incorrect: Despite the population increased, housing supply remained stable.
correct: Despite the increase in population, housing supply remained stable.
Although the population increased, housing supply remained stable.
grammar_notes.note_tr: Despite ardından isim, isim öbeği veya -ing gelir; although ardından tam cümle gelebilir.

examples.en: The library is to the north of the café.
The library is in the north of the campus.

grammar_notes.note_tr: İşlemi yapan kişi önemsiz veya bilinmiyorsa passive voice doğal bir tercihtir.
peak at + sayı; reach a peak of + sayı; rise by + artış miktarı; rise to + son değer.
number of sayılabilen isimlerle, amount of sayılamayan isimlerle kullanılır.
Surge ve soar güçlü artış ifade eder; dramatically eklemek gereksiz tekrar yaratabilir. Outnumber sayılabilen kişiler/nesneler içindir.

common_mistakes.incorrect: The number of people increased dramatically high.
common_mistakes.correct: The number of people increased dramatically.

common_mistakes.incorrect: The number of participants was fluctuated.
The figure was consisted of 5 stages.
The building was replaced with a park.
common_mistakes.correct: The building was replaced by a park.

common_mistakes.incorrect: The proportion of people were high.
common_mistakes.correct: The proportion of people was high.

sentence_upgrades.basic: The number of people increased a lot after 2010.
sentence_upgrades.improved: The number of participants increased significantly after 2010.
sentence_upgrades.advanced: Following a period of relative stability, the number of participants rose sharply after 2010, reaching approximately 60 by the end of the period.

sentence_upgrades.basic: The building was removed and a park was made.
sentence_upgrades.improved: The building was demolished and replaced by a park.
sentence_upgrades.advanced: The existing building was demolished to make way for a newly developed recreational area.

sentence_upgrades.improved: Housing accounted for 40% of total expenditure.
sentence_upgrades.advanced: Housing represented the largest share of household expenditure, accounting for approximately two-fifths of the total.

be demolished to make way for

study_strategy.line_graph_table: Trend fiilleri, değişim miktarları ve zaman ifadeleri.
study_strategy.bar_pie: Karşılaştırma, oran, sıralama ve farklılık ifadeleri.
study_strategy.process: Passive voice, sıralama ve dönüşüm fiilleri.
study_strategy.map: Konum, yıkım, inşa, genişleme ve dönüşüm.

additional_notes_tr: Task 1'de ileri seviye kelime kadar doğal ve hatasız collocation kullanımı önemlidir.
Overview genellikle temel eğilimleri ifade eder; ayrıntılı sayısal veriler body paragraflarına bırakılabilir.
Yüksek Band puanı yalnızca kelime seçimine bağlı değildir; Task Achievement, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource ve Grammatical Range and Accuracy birlikte değerlendirilir.
